mentions.name: Complex garden planner
mentions.description: This garden planner keeps track of gardens, orchards, and landscaping projects at both very large and very small scales, with a public alpha planned for the end of the month. It is a generalization of the author's earlier personal garden designer.
mentions.problem: The author's earlier personal garden designer was too specific to their own needs, so a general version requires a lot more work to be usable for a lot of people.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a complex garden planner to keep track of gardens, orchards, and landscaping projects. Meant for very large and very small scales. Public alpha at the end of this month, I hope.

You can see what it looks like right now here: https://x.com/simonsarris/status/2010359423806615907
